purpose: Minimal review annotations for supplied GridLock examples. These notes never replace workbook dates or coordinates.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Stevens Creek point is near the mapped dam substation, not its current OSM bounding-box center. Hooks missing. Single endpoint only; no verified route.

scope_schedule_evidence.identity_caution: Do not merge with 6809 G: original page 15 is a separate 6.5-mile project. Current plan page 20 calls 6809 G Hooks–Modoc and schedules it for 2027-12-31.

geometry.location_detail: Named Stevens Creek–Hooks and Little River/Plum Branch corridor; original spells Plumb. Includes 115kV and 46kV lines.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Thurmond matches the named 115 kV station to rounding. Hooks missing; single endpoint is not the line center.

geometry.location_detail: Between Hooks and Thurmond on existing right-of-way; rebuild with steel poles.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Jasper sample is near the mapped station but differs from its center. Okatie sample aligns with an unnamed 230 kV switching feature and the official route-map area; name and operator are absent from that OSM feature. Use station-area proxies at medium confidence.

scope_schedule_evidence.scope_caution: June 2032 in PSC Order 2026-482 page 5 is the later corridor reconductoring project, not the original #2 line-construction COD.

geometry.location_detail: Jasper substation in Hardeeville to Okatie substation in Okatie, South Carolina; public order page 2.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Queensborough spelling alias matches the 115 kV map feature. Nearby Santee Cooper Queensborough Switching is distinct. Fort Johnson missing. Compound scope unresolved.

scope_schedule_evidence.scope_caution: IRP names Queensboro–Fort Johnson and omits the Bayfront/James Island parenthetical. Do not assert separately that every component in the compound original title is complete without a utility scope crosswalk.

geometry.location_detail: Title names Queensboro, Ft Johnson, Bayfront and the Queensboro–James Island section. Description specifically describes replacement of Queensboro–Ft Johnson line and structures.

latest_evidence.status: Completed and in service for Queensboro–Fort Johnson named rebuild

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Bluffton matches the named 115 kV station. Okatie sample aligns with a 230 kV feature; precise 115 kV terminal not established. Retain only a station-area proxy.

geometry.location_detail: Named Okatie–Bluffton corridor; replacement of wooden H-frames with steel and conductor upgrade.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Evans and Thurmond match stations, but actual rebuild is Euchee Creek–Thurmond plus bus work. Reject full-line midpoint as work center. Euchee Creek missing.

scope_schedule_evidence.public_scope: Rebuild approximately 5.45 miles of the Euchee Creek–Thurmond Dam section of the named line; replace the main bus at Thurmond Dam.
scope_schedule_evidence.later_search_result: No matching replacement schedule or completion record located in the checked 2025 final and 2026 public materials. Absence does not prove completion, cancellation, or continued unchanged scope.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: McIntosh matches named Georgia Power 230 kV substation. Valid station proxy; exact reactor and two 0.1-mile line footprints unknown. Purrysburg is not required to locate the reactor equipment.

scope_schedule_evidence.public_scope: Install reactors at McIntosh on the Black and White McIntosh–Purrysburg tie lines, plus rebuild 0.1 miles of the GPC portion of each line.
scope_schedule_evidence.later_search_result: No newer sample-specific public schedule or completion confirmation found. A passed June 2026 need date is not evidence of completion.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Goshen matches named 115 kV station. McIntosh longitude differs by 0.408 mile between workbook rows and is not the actual rebuilt segment endpoint. Reject it for work geometry; Georgia Pacific endpoint missing. Use Goshen-only fallback with low geometry confidence.

scope_schedule_evidence.public_scope: Approximately 6.7 miles of the Goshen (Savannah)–Georgia Pacific (Rincon) section of the broader Goshen–McIntosh line.

latest_confirmed_plan.status: planned; preliminary regional plan; completion unconfirmed

scope_schedule_evidence.schedule_change: The 2025 final and 2026 preliminary SERTP both show 2028. Supersede the workbook's 2027 need date for latest-plan screening, while retaining the old value and provenance. Do not invent a month/day such as June 1, 2028.
scope_schedule_evidence.coordinate_caution: GPC_3 calls longitude -81.182105 at latitude 32.352116 McIntosh, approximately 0.41 mile west of GPC_2's same-named coordinate. OSM has a distinct West McIntosh 500 kV station nearby. Do not collapse these labels or repair the coordinate without endpoint evidence. The project actually terminates its rebuilt section at Georgia Pacific.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Mitchell matches 230 kV station. North Tifton sample maps to a 500 kV yard, while project specifies 230 kV. Exact terminal and line route unresolved; do not silently substitute nearby 115 kV yard.

scope_schedule_evidence.public_scope: Rebuild approximately 35.21 miles of the Mitchell–North Tifton 230 kV line.
scope_schedule_evidence.later_search_result: No newer matching public schedule or actual completion confirmation located. Past planned date does not establish completed status.

coordinate_assessment.verdict: Jesup and Ludowici match named 115 kV stations, but work is Jesup–North Jesup–Rayonier. Reject full-line midpoint as work center; missing segment endpoints.

scope_schedule_evidence.public_scope: Rebuild approximately 7.5 miles of the Jesup–North Jesup–Rayonier section of the broader Jesup–Ludowici Primary line.
scope_schedule_evidence.later_search_result: No later matching official public schedule or completion record located. Current Jesup–Offerman work is a different named project and was not treated as this sample.
